patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Clearbit share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Clearbit's shape. Choose Clearbit only if your buying job matches “HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelli” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans prospecting; Clearbit leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Clearbit share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Clearbit is HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelligence — usage/credits via HubSpot, Starter+ requir.
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Clearbit (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning prospecting vs Clearbit-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Clearbit — Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Clearbit: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; No standalone free plan; typically needs HubSpot Starter+.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Clearbit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Clearbit's motion (HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbou)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
